_readme: How many of the 15 cities set a new record-to-date in each year. This baselines the 2026 figure. Without it, '8 of 15 at a record' is unreadable: the reader cannot tell whether that is remarkable.
method: A city sets a record in year Y if its count to the same calendar day exceeds every prior year. Cities with fewer than 20 prior years are excluded from that year's count.
expected_no_trend_note: Sum of 1/n across the 15 records. Under a stationary climate the nth year of a record has probability 1/n of being a record.
may_not_say: 2026 is NOT the worst year on this measure. 2003 produced 12 on the same to-date basis and is inside living memory for this readership.
the_better_story: Three of the four worst years on this measure are the last four years. A pattern rather than an event.
caveat_2026_incomplete: 2026 is counted to 2-3 August with the season unfinished. Prior years are counted to the same date, so the comparison is like-for-like today, but 2026 can still add records before September.
